title: Capital project approval latency
accepted_explanation: Project teams submit poor business cases.
observations: Routine capital requests require six sequential approvals.
Two approvers review the same risk information.
No threshold distinguishes routine from exceptional decisions.
Escalations wait for a monthly governance meeting.
participant_claims: Executives say tighter governance protects capital discipline.
researcher_interpretations: Decision rights and approval architecture may be the dominant delay mechanism.
assumptions: Every approval adds unique risk control.
